name: @reactunity/monorepo

scripts.//typecheck: Separate from `build` since tsdown took over emitting: rolldown transpiles per file and the dts step does not do full semantic analysis, so a build passing no longer means the types do. CI runs both.

//typescript: On 7 here, but the workspace is deliberately split rather than uniform, so check the package you are editing. TypeScript 7 is the native compiler and it changes two things that matter: it ships no JS API (its export map points `.` at lib/version.cjs, so `require('typescript')` yields `{ version, versionMajorMinor }` and `resolve.sync('typescript')` fails with MODULE_NOT_FOUND), and it *removes* compiler options rather than deprecating them. Nothing at this root touches either -- the scripts here are Biome, husky and tsx, and tsx transpiles with esbuild -- so this copy and packages/create are on 7. Eight packages stay on 6.x and each says why next to its own pin: packages/renderer and packages/material (TS5108, `target=ES5` and `esModuleInterop=false` have both been removed), packages/scripts and the four apps that build through it (three `resolve.sync('typescript')` call sites), and docs (@astrojs/check peer-depends on `^5.0.0 || ^6.0.0`).
